text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Mmph! Trainer, just 'cause you're tired 
doesn't mean you should go all limp! Have 
some dignity!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"At times like this, working up a sweat to 
clear your head is the best! Now that 
that's settled, come do some laps with 
me!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'll chase those clouds wherever they 
go...!
